name: Office Studio - Offline PDF, Docs, Sheets and Slides editor
description: Offline PDF, spreadsheet, document and slides editor. Everything runs locally: no server, no cloud, no telemetry, no accounts.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' data: blob: https://live.dodopayments.com; frame-src 'none'; child-src 'none';
